verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OKWAGALA okwo
Okw'Omulokozi
Kwe yanjagala nze
Nange-atasaanira;
Kale nze-ani
Omwonoonyi?
Naye yafa ku lwange nze.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Baatendereza nnyo
Nga bayimba-ennyimba,
Nga bayimba-ennyimba,
Nga bagamba bonna:
Ozaana waggulu!
Ate-amangu
Ne bagamba:
Komerera-Omulokozi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tewalina nnyumba,
Ggwe eyatonda-ensi.
Mu kufa, bonna bonna
Baakwabulira
Njogere ntya
-Omulokozi
Olw'okunjagala bw'otyo?

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yaleka-ekitiibwa
N'aleetera-abantu
Obulokozi bwe
Ffe-abatasaanira:
Yanjagala
Nze-omwonoonyi
N'awaayo byonna ku lwange.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Naye yakola ki?
Yawonya-abalwadde;
Abalema bonna
-Era Ne bamuzibe
Yabawonya.
Kya kitalo,
Kaakano bamuduulira!

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ka mbeere nga nnyimba
Ku mukwano gwange;
Ye Kabaka, naye
N'anjagala bw'atyo
Mu bulamu
Bwange bwonna,
Ka nkwagale-Omulokozi
